column3: The Home DO is the auth boundary: Home.fetch checks the deploy token or the rotated digest held in memory (read once from kv via raw storage, replaced by session.rotate) on every route; the Worker rejects bearer-less requests and pre-checks only PUT /files
column4: A rotated-token request cost two DO requests and one kv row read (POST /v1/auth then the forwarded request); the DO is only reachable through the Worker, so checking there is equivalent and the in-memory digest makes it free
column5: src/worker.test.ts "Home auth boundary": every route refuses a direct call without a valid token; measured on main 2 requests + 1 kv read per rotated-token request, after 1 request + 0 reads
